## Methods

```{python}
#| label: pdf-gwas-methods
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
from bioreport.software import software_records
from bioreport.config import load_project_metadata
workflow_config = load_project_metadata()
display(Markdown(
    '- **Association model**: GEMMA linear mixed model (LMM, Wald test) with the cohort-wide centered kinship matrix K '
    'correcting population structure and relatedness; covariates include the intercept and trait-declared PCs from the LD-pruned PCA.'))
display(Markdown(
    '- **Multiple testing**: Bonferroni, threshold = alpha/(family_size x M) with M the trait valid P count '
    '(recorded in the association metadata; the report never re-derives it).'))
display(Markdown(
    '- **QC strategy**: HWE filtering disabled and related materials retained by default for selfing/inbreeding plants; '
    'four stages (pre-geno -> mind -> geno/maf/mac) executed independently with full audit trails.'))
```

## Software Versions

```{python}
#| label: pdf-gwas-software
#| output: asis
records = software_records(workflow_config)
frame = pd.DataFrame(records)
if not frame.empty:
    display(Markdown('| Software | Version | Source |\n|---|---|---|\n' + '\n'.join(
        f"| {row.get('Software','')} | {row.get('Version','')} | {row.get('Source','')} |"
        for _, row in frame.iterrows())))
else:
    display(Markdown('Software versions not registered (software_versions missing).'))
```
